title: Unveiling Covert Toxicity in Multimodal Data via Toxicity Association Graphs: A Graph-Based Metric and Interpretable Detection Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting covert toxicity in multimodal data, which is an ethical and safety assessment task. It introduces the Covert Toxic Dataset (CTD) for benchmarking these models and specifically includes a 'Morality' category in its toxic taxonomy, directly engaging with the ethical classification of content as harmful vs. benign.
